name: slre
url: https://github.com/cesanta/slre (git clone --depth 1, commit b92b363aa7a7814b8d224f1007503802d702872a, 2026-08-26; docs read from src/docs/syntax.md, api.md, overview.md)
files_measured: src/slre.c (single engine TU, 437 lines, with src/slre.h). unit_test.c NOT measured. Whole file = engine; nothing excluded.
per_function_top: Cortex-M4 -Os: bar 876; slre_match 560 (foo/baz/setup_branch_points/is_metacharacter inlined into it); match_op 300 (match_set partly, hextoi/toi inlined); doh 108; get_op_len 58 (set_len inlined); op_len 22; .rodata metacharacter string "^$().[]*+?|\\Ssdbfnrtv" 22. That is all 7 sections (sum 1946).
excluded_functions: none. slre.c has no test/dump code; DBG() expands to nothing unless -DSLRE_DEBUG (which would pull printf). unit_test.c was not compiled.
libc_deps: arm-none-eabi-nm -u slre_m4.o: _ctype_ (newlib ctype table via isdigit/isspace/isxdigit/tolower macros; adds ~257 B flash outside this TU), strchr (is_metacharacter), strlen (pattern length). No malloc, no memcmp, no setjmp, no printf/stdio at link time (stdio.h is included but unused without SLRE_DEBUG).
ram_model: No malloc, no globals (reentrant). struct regex_info = 2420 B on ARM (bracket_pair[100] x16 + branch[100] x8 + 5 ints; MAX_BRACKETS/MAX_BRANCHES=100 are compile-time constants) lives on the stack inside slre_match: -fstack-usage says slre_match 2480 B, bar 88 B, doh 40 B, match_op 8, get_op_len 8. Recursion bar<->doh: depth grows with the number of quantifiers and group nesting in the PATTERN (each quantifier matches the 'rest of the regex' in a nested bar() call; each '(' adds doh+bar), not with text length. Caller supplies caps[] (ptr+len, 8 B each on ARM). No compile step: the pattern is re-parsed on every slre_match call (my driver calls it once per start offset).
features_verified: IMPLEMENTED (read in slre.c and probed with driver): byte literals; '.' = ANY byte incl. newline (match_op line 144); '^' = offset 0 of the buffer passed to the current bar() call, '$' = end of that buffer; escapes \s \S \d (ctype-based, ASCII in C locale), \n \r \t \f \v, \b = BACKSPACE 0x08 (not word boundary), \xHH byte, \ + one of ^$().[]*+?|\ only; [set] [^set] with byte ranges a-z, escapes inside sets incl \] \- \\ \s \d \n (escapes inside sets are not validated); quantifiers * + ? greedy, *? +? lazy; alternation | (top level and inside groups); capturing groups (...) with captures (ptr,len); flag SLRE_IGNORE_CASE = ASCII tolower on literals and ranges; error codes for unbalanced brackets, invalid escapes, leading quantifier, empty group. NOT IMPLEMENTED: {n} {n,} {n,m} ('{' is a literal, '\{' rejected); \w \W \D (rejected -6); \b \B word boundary; ?? lazy optional (rejected -2); (?:...) non-capturing groups (rejected -2 or swallowed to nomatch inside a loop); empty group () (rejected); escapes of punctuation outside the meta set (\{ \} \- \/ ... rejected outside sets); UTF-8 awareness (pure byte matcher: '.' and [..] consume one byte, quantifier after a multibyte literal applies to its last byte); '.' excluding newline; multiline. API: slre_match returns only the END offset of the leftmost match (baz() adds the start index to the length and discards it) - the match START is not exposed; caps give group spans only when non-empty (empty capture stays unset).
difftest: python3 difftest.py ./driver corpus_seed1.jsonl -> cases=2088 checked=2081 pass=1089 fail=992 timeouts=0 group_spans_checked=55 (~8 s wall). Classification of the 992 failures (classify2.py, construct-first): MISSING FEATURES ~862: {n,m}/{n}/{n,} 527 (corpus uses it in 794 cases); \w \W \D 184 (+4 \b/\B inside those); (?:...) 94; ?? lazy optional 25; empty group () 20; \{ \} escaped literal punctuation 12. SEMANTICS DIFFERENCES ~110: byte-wise matching of UTF-8 (. [..] \S consume one byte, ranges by byte) 86; empty alternative skipped when a later alternative matches non-empty and empty capture reported unset (doh() loops while result<=0) ~23; '.' matches newline 2; empty group capture reported (-1,-1) instead of (x,x) 2 (Python-vs-slre; part of the previous). BUGS ~18: alternation committed to the first matching branch with no backtracking, and groups in later branches get the wrong bracket index ((a|ab)c on abc, (a)|(b) on b -> nomatch) 7; [..] at end of text reads 1 byte past buf_len and matches the NUL -> span end beyond text ([^a-c]+ on ABCd -> 3 5) 4; '?' greedy-committed, never retries empty (a?ab on ab -> nomatch) 2; lazy *?/+? with nothing following matches one iteration (a*? on aaa -> [0,1]) 1; (a*)+ on b -> nomatch ('+' requires progress) 1; nested groups mis-indexed ((a(b))(c) on abc -> nomatch) 1; lazy/'$' interplay 1. TIMEOUTS: 0. The 7 expected-error cases were skipped by the harness (slre errored on 6 of them; the '^' prefix could mask leading-quantifier errors so the driver reports those itself).
caveats: (1) Driver adaptation: slre exposes no match start, so driver.c replicates slre's own scan loop (baz()) - it prefixes the pattern with '^' (in slre '^' means offset 0 of the buffer passed in) and calls slre_match(text+p) for p=0..len, stopping at the first match; if the user pattern starts with '^' only p=0 is tried, exactly like baz(). This reproduces slre's semantics (including its quirk that '^' in a later alternative matches at any scan offset) and adds a re-parse per offset; it changes no result. Groups counted by the same '(' stepping as foo(). (2) Sizes are for slre.c alone; newlib's _ctype_ table + strchr + strlen (~0.4-0.5 KB) are extra at link time. (3) '.' inside slre never excludes newline and '$' inside a group sees a TRUNCATED buffer length (the group is retried by shortening s_len), so '$'/anchor behaviour inside groups is unusual. (4) [..] reads s[buf_len] - benign with NUL-terminated buffers, an out-of-bounds read otherwise. (5) The corpus is heavy on {n,m}/\w/(?: (794/663/455 of 2088 cases), so the 52% pass rate mostly reflects missing syntax; but the engine also fails basic backtracking on alternation and '?'. (6) License: GPLv2 or commercial (docs/license.md). (7) Overview.md claims 'about 5kB' x86 - measured 3713 B x86-64 / 1946 B Cortex-M4 at -Os. Docs claim '?' is non-greedy; code is greedy-committed. (8) Stack: 2480 B per slre_match call regardless of pattern; tunable only by editing MAX_BRACKETS/MAX_BRANCHES.
